commit.message:
8394898: Make variables cause overhead

For every spawn, GNU make iterates all variables to find the exported ones. The JDK build has many variables and many spawns, so a significant fraction of make's CPU time is iterating variables during a JDK build.

This change undefines variables from two frequently used macros, SetupNativeCompilationBody and CreateCompiledNativeFileBody, after the variables are no longer needed.

This simple change removes 60% of the variables from the JtregNativeHotspot submake and 55% of make variables from the hotspot submake. Overall, this saves 38% of make CPU time on a clean build to run one jtreg test.
